name: linkedin-tracker
description: Standalone, per-BDR LinkedIn connection-request + cold-call lead tracker. Reconciles the BDR's own LinkedIn inbox against a per-BDR Notion tracking page, @-mentions them to send a same-day first message when someone connects, and on send runs builds a lead list from their downloaded Salesforce reports and sends connection requests via Claude in Chrome (never via the MCP). Self-contained: bundles its own read-only LinkedIn MCP and permission deny-list; independent of the Conversation Hub / convohub-sync plugins. Works for every rep on their own LinkedIn login and Notion identity, resolved per run.
